Short title and commencement

PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND
HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the People's
Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part IV, 6th October, 1996]
No.PAS/Legis‑B‑13/96,
dated 6‑10‑1996.‑‑The People's Medical College and
Hospital Nawabshah (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 22nd August, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 16th September, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Act may be called the People's Medical
College and Hospital Nawabshah (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 18 of the Sindh Act XIII of 1995

PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
PEOPLE'S MEDICAL COLLEGE AND
HOSPITAL NAWABSHAH (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the People's
Medical College and Hospital Nawabshah Act, 1995
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary,
Part IV, 6th October, 1996]
No.PAS/Legis‑B‑13/96,
dated 6‑10‑1996.‑‑The People's Medical College and
Hospital Nawabshah (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 22nd August, 1996 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 16th September, 1996 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of
Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 18 of
the Sindh Act XIII of 1995.‑‑In the People's Medical College
and Hospital, Nawabshah Act, 1995, in section 18:‑‑
(1) for subsection (2), the
following shall be substituted:‑‑
"(2) The
option under subsection (1) shall be made, and submitted to Government within
ninety days of the commencement of the People's Medical College (Amendment)
Act, 1996";
(2) in subsection (3), for word
"Government", the word "the Board" shall be substituted;
(3) after subsection (3), the
following new subsection shall be added:‑‑
"(4) Where
the services of a person who has not made an option under subsection (2) are
required in the public interest by the Medical College, such person shall,
notwithstanding the terms and conditions of his service be transferred to the
Medical College and on such transfer he shall be deemed to be on deputation on
the terms and conditions as Government may determine"
